title: Free Night Awards Training Q&A: Stays Extra on Replacement Validity
content:
**What does the stays extra add?**
For a replacement among the Free Night Awards deposited because an award came back from a reservation the hotel relocated after its expiry date had passed, the stays extra adds months to the replacement validity months before the expiry date is worked out.

**How is it set?**
The stays extra adds up the nights of the stay night credits posted to the membership in the twelve calendar months before the reissue, card anniversary night credits not counted: at least the upper stay nights earn the upper stays extra, at least the lower stay nights the lower stays extra, and fewer nothing.

| Stay night credits, twelve months before the reissue | Stays extra |
|---|---|
| 40 nights or more (upper stay nights) | 2 months (upper stays extra) |
| 20 to 39 nights (lower stay nights) | 1 month (lower stays extra) |
| 19 nights or fewer | No stays extra |

**Which postings are stay night credits?**
The Ashbury Rewards night credit postings for stays, each added by its nights. Card anniversary night credits are not counted.

**A hypothetical account?**
In the twelve months before the reissue the membership shows stay night credits of 16 and 21 nights and a card anniversary credit of 10 nights. The stay night credits add up to 37 nights, so the stays extra is 1 month.
